final: WITH g AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer GROUP BY store_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), r AS (SELECT g.store_id, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM r), f AS (SELECT r.store_id, r.cnt, r.share, r.cnt - a.avg_cnt AS diff FROM r JOIN a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL) SELECT store_id, cnt, share, diff FROM f ORDER BY store_id
